attackers_goals: Evading detection by indirectly executing their malicious programs.
description: Pcalua.exe (Program Compatibility Assistant) is used for running old programs that have compatibility issues. Attackers can use pcalua.exe to indirectly execute their malicious programs.
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Indirect command execution using the Program Compatibility Assistant
